title: ADKS (Adolescentenpanel Democratische Kernwaarden en Schoolloopbanen)
descriptions: The ADKS / DAPDV aims to monitor the development of democratic values among adolescents and examine the role that schools can play in this development. To achieve this, researchers from the University of Amsterdam collected data from students in around 40 secondary schools across the Netherlands between October 2018 and March 2024. These students were surveyed on an annual basis to track their development.
